{{Quote|That's all of 'em. You're clear to take off, transport ''Luminous''.''"<br />"''That was close! Thanks for the cover, Commander Skywalker!|Luke Skywalker opens a launch window for the ''Luminous'' during the evacuation of Yavin 4|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
The '''''Luminous''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] attached to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Luminous'' was modified to hold a boosted [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], while suffering corresponding diminished [[Armor/Legends|armor]] strength and cargo capacity. Its crew was trained for reconnaissance and rapid [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] duties. In the wake of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Luminous'' helped facilitate a successful [[Attack on Yavin 4|evacuation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The ''Luminous'' also participated in the Rebel Alliance's attack on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
The ''Luminous'' was a modified<ref name="Death Star Limited" /> [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]]<ref name="Databank" /> of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="Death Star Limited" /> Originally manufactured by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]],<ref name="Databank" /> the modified ''Luminous'' featured a boosted [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] at the expense of diminished [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and cargo capacity.<ref name="Death Star Limited" /> The medium [[Transport/Legends|transport]] measured ninety [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and was armed minimally with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="Databank" /> protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shielding system]],<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> and equipped with a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]].<ref name="Death Star Limited" />

==History==
{{Quote|Excellent, Luke! That was a vital transport. Let's just hope they get past the Imperial blockade.|General Jan Dodonna, following the ''Luminous''{{'s}} departure from Yavin 4|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
The ''Luminous'' was a product of Gallofree Yards,<ref name="Databank" /> a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer that went bankrupt several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Many of Gallofree Yards' remaining transports ended up in the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|317|Gallofree Yards, Inc.}}</ref> The Rebellion purchased these<ref name="Databank" /> outdated<ref name="New Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> vessels at greatly reduced prices, but they required a fair amount of maintenance. The ''Luminous'' was one such transport<ref name="Databank" /> serving in the Alliance Fleet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

[[File:LuminousIsland-RSIII.png|thumb|left|275px|The Rebel transport ''Luminous'' awaits safe departure from Yavin 4.]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date1">The ''Luminous'' appears in the ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' level "Revenge of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]," which is set just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. This [[Time/Legends|time]] frame corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the ''Luminous'' played a vital role in [[Attack on Yavin 4|evacuating]] the Rebellion's [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] during a large-scale [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invasion. Grounded on a small island while preparing to depart the base, the ''Luminous'' fell under attack from a wave of [[Imperial loader shuttle]]s attempting to dispatch [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] to the surface. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], flying an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] in defense of the Rebel evacuation, succeeded in destroying each of the loader [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to open a launch window for the ''Luminous''. As the ''Luminous'' departed Yavin 4, it would next need to pass through a sizable Imperial [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] waiting in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

Years later, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the ''Luminous'' took part in<ref name="Date2">The ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] focuses on subjects participating in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The ''Luminous''{{'s}} [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/DeathStarII-Light/large/luminous.gif inclusion] in the ''Death Star II Limited'' set therefore effectively establishes its participation in the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] battle.</ref> the climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], in which the largest [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] ever assembled in the Rebellion's history<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> attacked and destroyed the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Luminous''{{'s}} crew was trained for reconnaissance and swift [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] transport.<ref name="Death Star Limited" /> A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Unidentified Luminous crewman|crewman]] serving aboard the ''Luminous'' [[Comlink/Legends|communicated]] with Luke Skywalker during the transport's contested evacuation from Yavin 4.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is transport ''Luminous''. We're taking heavy fire from those walkers!|The ''Luminous'' may be destroyed if the player does not protect its evacuation in ''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike''|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
The ''Luminous'' was created for the [[July]] [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. The transport's inclusion in the set effectively established its participation in the large Rebel fleet fighting during the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Date2" /> as seen in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

For the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', the ''Luminous'' appears in the game's second level, "Revenge of the Empire," as one of the Rebel transports attempting to facilitate the Alliance's evacuation of its Yavin 4 base. The player, as Luke Skywalker, must defend the ''Luminous'' from attack by destroying a force of six inbound Imperial loader shuttles ferrying AT-ST [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. If the player allows any of the shuttles to land, each unloads a single AT-ST, which then begins firing on the grounded ''Luminous''. As it is possible to quickly destroy the shuttles before they can unload any AT-STs,<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> the exact nature by which the player satisfies this game objective is left ambiguous for this article.
